title: Ceragon Expands its Multi-Vendor Wireless Portfolio with Sub-6 GHz Solutions, Strengthening its End-to-End Connectivity Offering
summary: Ceragon Expands its Multi-Vendor Wireless Portfolio with Sub-6 GHz Solutions, Strengthening its End-to-End Connectivity Offering
body_markdown:
*Collaboration with RADWIN, as one of its sub-6 GHz partners, broadens Ceragon's ability to support service providers and private network customers with complementary wireless technologies.*


**Rosh Ha’ain, Israel, November 3, 2026 -**


Ceragon (NASDAQ: CRNT),


a leading solutions provider of end-to-end wireless connectivity, today announced that it is expanding its portfolio into sub-6 GHz wireless access through a new collaboration with RADWIN. Under the terms of the collaboration, Ceragon will serve as a global solution provider of RADWIN's sub-6 GHz offerings, complementing its existing microwave and millimeter-wave connectivity portfolio. The expansion supports Ceragon’s broader strategy to provide customers with a more complete range of wireless solutions, from transport to access.


RADWIN specializes in advanced wireless access technologies, particularly high-capacity, long-range connectivity, and beamforming in challenging RF environments. With the addition of RADWIN’s sub-6 GHz access solutions, Ceragon can address a wider range of network requirements, supporting applications from business broadband to video surveillance, industrial connectivity, and critical infrastructure. For service providers and private network operators, this means greater flexibility to choose the right wireless technology for different coverage, capacity, and deployment needs, while working with a single partner.


For customers and channel partners, the expanded portfolio means:


- **Simpler sourcing and procurement.** Customers and channel partners can access a broader range of wireless solutions through Ceragon, reducing the complexity of working with multiple suppliers.


- **A path toward unified network management.** Ceragon is developing a multi-vendor network management strategy to provide greater visibility and control across different wireless technologies.


- **Dedicated sales and technical expertise.** Ceragon has added a specialized team to accelerate go-to-market execution and support customers and partners in evaluating solutions, planning deployments, and accessing technical support.


The expanded portfolio will be available through Ceragon's global sales organization and its network of distributors and channel partners, serving service providers, wireless ISPs, utilities, enterprises, and other private network operators.


"Our customers increasingly want one partner who can help them build and manage more of their wireless network, from access to transport," said Doron Arazi, CEO of Ceragon. "By adding RADWIN's sub-6 GHz solutions to our end-to-end offering, we're giving customers more flexibility in how they design and expand their networks. This is an important step in our strategy to deliver more complete wireless solutions and serve a broader range of customer needs."


Ceragon will be present at WISPAPALOOZA in Las Vegas, November 2-5, at booth #902 to answer further questions.


**About Ceragon**


Ceragon (NASDAQ: CRNT) is the global innovator and leading solutions provider of end-to-end wireless connectivity, specializing in transport, access, and AI-powered managed & professional services. Through our commitment to excellence, we empower customers to elevate operational efficiency and enrich the quality of experience for their end users.


Our customers include service providers, utilities, public safety organizations, government agencies, energy companies, and more, who rely on our wireless expertise and cutting-edge solutions for 5G & 4G broadband wireless connectivity, mission-critical services, and an array of applications that harness our ultra-high reliability and speed. Ceragon solutions are deployed by more than 600 service providers, as well as more than 1,600 private network owners, in more than 130 countries. Through our innovative, end-to-end solutions, covering hardware, software, and managed & professional services, we enable our customers to embrace the future of wireless technology with confidence, shaping the next generation of connectivity and service delivery. Ceragon delivers extremely reliable, fast to deploy, high-capacity wireless solutions for a wide range of communication network use cases, optimized to lower TCO through minimal use of spectrum, power, real estate, and labor resources - driving simple, quick, and cost-effective network modernization and positioning Ceragon as a leading solutions provider for the “connectivity everywhere” era.
